Parent 潮州三环 (2025年年报 六、2 *1; 2026年半年报 六、2 *1): its 高新技术企业 certificate GR202344010732 covers 2023-01-01 to 2025-12-31, and it paid 15% in FY2025. For 2026H1 it 'provisionally' (暂按) pays 15% under 国家税务总局公告2017年第24号, meaning the HNTE renewal was still pending at the 2026H1 report.

Tax reconciliation convention (七、所得税费用(2)): '按法定/适用税率计算的所得税费用' is exactly 15% x 利润总额 in every period FY2023-2026H1, i.e. the parent's HNTE rate. '子公司适用不同税率的影响' is the uplift from subsidiaries on 20%/25%/foreign rates. The only large permanent item is '研发费用加计扣除' (R&D super-deduction).

Government grant accounting policy (2025年年报 五; 2026年半年报 五、28 政府补助). Asset-related grants go to 递延收益 and are amortised to P&L over the related asset's useful life; any unamortised balance on disposal is released. Income-related grants that compensate future costs are deferred and released when the costs are recognised. Grants related to ordinary activities go to 其他收益 or offset costs; others go to 营业外收支. Where a grant cannot be classified, it is treated as income-related.

Deferred tax policy (2025年年报 五、29): DTA/DTL are measured at the tax rate expected to apply when the asset is recovered or the liability settled. DTA is recognised to the extent it is probable that taxable income will be available. The group offsets DTA and DTL (net presentation) from FY2025, with 互抵金额 of 98,089,984.24 at FY2025末.

Non-recurring classification (第二节 非经常性损益): 增值税加计抵减 is classified as recurring ('与公司生产经营业务密切相关'); amounts are FY2023 46,131,557.33, FY2024 63,001,737.14, FY2025 27,468,772.34, 2025H1 19,018,046.64 and 2026H1 21,023,874.72. All 其他收益 government grants are treated as non-recurring, so 扣非 profit excludes them fully. All 营业外收入/支出 lines are non-recurring.
